<!-- The features as a grid of cards, tiles or bordered cells (the body of FeatureGrid). Icons are Lucide names. -->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Feature } from "../blocks/feature-grid.types";

  export type FeatureCardsProps = {
    features: Feature[];
    cols?: "1-2" | "1-3" | "1-4";
    item?: "card" | "tile" | "cell";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Card from "../primitives/card/card.svelte";
  import CardContent from "../primitives/card/card-content.svelte";
  import CardHeader from "../primitives/card/card-header.svelte";
  import CardTitle from "../primitives/card/card-title.svelte";
  import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import IconBadge from "../primitives/iconbadge/icon-badge.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import Title from "../primitives/title/title.svelte";
  import { defaults } from "../presets/defaults";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let { features, cols = "1-3", item = "card" }: FeatureCardsProps = $props();
</script>

<Grid
  cols={cols}
  class={
    (item as string) === "cell" ? cn("w-full gap-px overflow-hidden bg-border p-px", defaults.features.cells)
    : "gap-6"
  }
  data-testid="feature-grid"
>
  {#each features as feature (feature.id)}
    {#if ((item as string) === "tile")}
      <Card variant="compact" data-testid="feature-card">
        <Group gap="4" align="start">
          <LucideIcon name={feature.icon} size={20} />
          <Stack gap="2">
            <Title as={3} size="base" weight="bold">
              {feature.title}
            </Title>
            <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {feature.text}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
        </Group>
      </Card>
    {:else if ((item as string) === "cell")}
      <Stack
        gap="2"
        align="center"
        class="h-full gap-8 bg-background px-6 py-12 text-center"
        data-testid="feature-card"
      >
        <IconBadge variant="primary" size="xl" data-testid="feature-icon">
          <LucideIcon name={feature.icon} size={24} />
        </IconBadge>
        <Title as={3} size="xl" weight="semibold" class="leading-6">
          {feature.title}
        </Title>
        <Text size="sm" weight="semibold" class="leading-5 text-muted-foreground">
          {feature.text}
        </Text>
      </Stack>
    {:else}
      <Card variant="default" data-testid="feature-card">
        <CardHeader class="flex flex-col gap-4">
          <LucideIcon name={feature.icon} size={24} />
          <CardTitle as={3}>
            {feature.title}
          </CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {feature.text}
          </Text>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    {/if}
  {/each}
</Grid>
